He experienced severe neutropenia (grade 4) and multiple grade 2 toxicities (cough, dyspnea, fatigue, infusion reaction, cardiac arrhythmia, GI symptoms). This indicates significant treatment-related morbidity and reduced physiologic reserve. Functional status is likely declining due to cumulative toxicity, increasing frailty risk. Prognosis is guarded; goals of care should prioritize quality of life and symptom management.
